question: Mopin is an agricultural festival celebrated in the state of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mopin** is a festival celebrated by the **Galo tribe** of **Arunachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• This festival is usually celebrated in the month of **April.**
 
• Mopin is celebrated to thank the **gods for a good harvest** and to pray for the well-being of the community.
 
• During this festival, people wear **traditional attire**, perform traditional dances, and offer prayers and sacrifices to the gods.
 
• The festival is also known for its unique customs like the **Mithun dance **and the **Popir dance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihar** is a state in eastern India, which is known for its rich history and culture.
 
• The state celebrates many festivals like** Chhath Puja, Durga Puja, and Diwali**.
 
• **West Bengal** is a state in eastern India, which is known for its rich culture and literature.
 
• The state celebrates many festivals like **Rash Mela, Poush Mela, Vasant Panchami and Ratha Yatra Kolkata.**
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** is a state in northern India, which is known for its scenic beauty and adventure sports.
 
• The state celebrates many festivals like **Pori Festival Lahaul, Minjar Fair Chamba, Summer Festival Shimla, Halda Festival and Sazo Festival.**
